title: New structural topologies in 4f-metal cluster chemistry from vertex-sharing butterfly units: {Ln7} complexes exhibiting slow magnetization relaxation and ligand-centred emissions

synthesis.procedure: Under aerobic conditions, solid Gd(NO3)3·6H2O (0.045 g, 0.1 mmol) was added to a stirred orange solution of saphH2 (0.043 g, 0.2 mmol) and NEt3 (84 μL, 0.6 mmol) in Me2CO (20 mL). The resulting yellow solution was stirred for 30 min until all solids dissolved and the colour intensified, then filtered. The filtrate was left to evaporate slowly at room temperature. After 2 days, thin needle-like crystals of 1 suitable for X-ray diffraction were collected by filtration, washed with cold Me2CO (2 × 2 mL) and dried in air. The air-dried solid is slightly hygroscopic and analysed as 1·2H2O.

synthesis.vessel_or_method: aerobic solution synthesis followed by slow evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate evaporated slowly at room temperature; crystals collected by filtration, washed with cold Me2CO (2 × 2 mL) and dried in air

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility (2.0–300 K, 0.3 T) shows room-temperature χMT matching seven uncoupled Gd(III) ions, remaining ~55 cm3 K mol−1 to 40 K then falling to 22.21 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K, consistent with weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic exchange. Magnetization at 2 K approaches 47.7 μB at high field versus 49 μB expected for seven uncoupled Gd(III). Solid-state photoluminescence is ligand-centred: excitation at 400 nm gives green emission at 540 nm with a weaker band at 485 nm (room temperature).

properties.summary: χMT at room temperature agrees with seven uncoupled Tb(III) ions, stays ~78 cm3 K mol−1 from 300 to 130 K, then decreases to 44.07 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K (Stark depopulation plus weak AF coupling). Magnetization vs field at 2 K does not saturate. Zero-dc-field ac susceptibility shows no out-of-phase χM″ signals. Solid-state emission is ligand-centred (λex 400 nm; λem 540 and 485 nm at room temperature).

properties.summary: χMT matches seven uncoupled Dy(III) ions at room temperature, remains ~98 cm3 K mol−1 from 300 to 130 K, then falls to 63.60 cm3 K mol−1 at 2.0 K. Magnetization at 2 K does not saturate. Zero-field ac data show frequency-dependent χM″ tails below ~7 K, indicating slow magnetization relaxation of a weakly barriered SMM. A Bartolomé analysis of ln(χ″/χ′) vs 1/T gives Ea ≈ 3.0(1) cm−1 [4.3(1) K] and τ0 = 8.3(2)×10−6 s. Solid-state emission is ligand-centred (λex 400 nm; λem 540 and 485 nm).
